column1: # Game profile of Bayonetta 2 (Switch, update v131072 = 1.2; English, Japanese, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Korean, Simplified and Traditional Chinese). On the Mac from the boot
# through the title, a new game (Story, Normal), the opening narration and the prologue's cutscene, the tutorial and the prologue's first fights on the jet, at 60 fps in play (30 in its
# PlatinumGames' own engine (its Wii U engine, not Bayonetta 3's) on NVN, SDK 3.6.0, the oldest SDK so far (no other game's sdk build). Modules main + subsdk0 (NVN's GLSLC, which main
# imports but did not call on the route above) + sdk; Wwise sound through two AudioOuts; CRI's file system (CPK) and Sofdec movies (USM), both decoded by the game's own code.
# RomFS: six CRI CPK archives (data000.cpk …, 9.5 GB, 6,091 files, 12 GB of them CRILAYLA-compressed) holding PlatinumGames DAT archives, beside the USM movies (movie/) and the Wwise
# sound (sound/). The shaders are BNSH files, one stage each ('.vso' / '.pso' members of shader.dat, shader2.dat and shadereff.dat in data000.cpk; shader_split.py cpk_jobs, cpk.py)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# full: the camera is on the right stick
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = GLSLC)
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): nninitStartup sets a heap of the pool − used memory (3.11 GB here). The 4 GB block of the other games without virtual address
# memory (256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region)
# the rewritten modules are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory (the game's SetHeapSize asks for pool − used)
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; the BNSH files in data000.cpk) ----
